data.body: AC amendment (gap analysis from 982a, CRITICAL): The db rollback-pair emission must make each emitted task carry a reserved tag migration-role:rollback / migration-role:rollback-verification (and the forward-migration task a role tag) so the sprint two-pass consumer (982a) can pair halves deterministically.
